title: Hario V60 Pour Over Coffee Dripper Set
description_en: The Hario V60 is the dripper that sparked the global third-wave coffee revolution. Made in Japan from heat-resistant glass, its signature spiral ribs promote perfect extraction every pour.
description_ja: 世界のサードウェーブコーヒーを牽引したハリオV60。日本製耐熱ガラス、独自のスパイラルリブが一杯ごとに理想の抽出を実現。
